eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Kenosha, WI; at 7:52 PM on AUG 24, 2020 Effective until 11:52 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Kenosha Sheriffs Department. This message is being sent at 2147 hours at 08/23/20. This is an advisory message for your area regarding a large scale act of civil unrest in area of 2800 block of 40th Street, Kenosha. For your safety and convenience, please avoid traveling through that area until further notice. Thank you for your patience and cooperation.
